paragraphs: Q-Free sells tolling systems, and its homepage frames them as a way to increase traffic flow and reach funding goals. The about page describes the range as hardware and software solutions for tolling and traffic management applications.

One named software family is Dynamic Software, described on its product page as the first traffic signal control software purpose-built for cybersecurity. That page addresses transportation agencies, and says the software family helps agencies protect critical infrastructure on connected networks. The about page names the customer only in general terms, as transportation operators served with technology that improves roadway safety and reduces congestion.

quote.text: Connecting people, communities, and data through intelligent, safe, and sustainable traffic management solutions.
